The Cardinal were led by fourth-year head coach [[Jerod Haase]] and played their home games at [[Maples Pavilion]] as a member of the [[Pac-12 Conference]]. They finished the season 20–12, 9–9 in Pac-12 play to finish in seventh place. They lost in the first round of the [[2020 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball tournament|Pac-12 tournament]] to [[2019–20 California Golden Bears men's basketball team|California]]. == Previous season == The [[2018–19 Stanford Cardinal men's basketball team|Cardinal]] finished the [[2018–19 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2018–19 season]] 15–16, 8–10 in [[2018–19 Pac-12 Conference men's basketball season|Pac-12 play]] to finish in a three-way tie for eighth place, losing the tie-breakers against Arizona and USC ultimately finishing in tenth place.
